entries.role: Operations Research (NUS System Design Project), Contract

text.default: Build an AI-driven put-away recommendation system for STMicroelectronics' Singapore warehouse, combining picking history, demand forecasts, and live capacity to replace experience-based slotting decisions.
text.deep: Build an AI-driven put-away recommendation system for STMicroelectronics' Singapore semiconductor warehouse, combining picking history, demand forecasts, and live capacity to replace experience-based slotting with systematic, capacity-aware storage recommendations.

text.default: Build vision systems for camera ISP enhancement, super-resolution, and image restoration under motion and low light.

capability-first.text: Advance camera ISP enhancement, super-resolution, and image restoration under motion and low light.
capability-first.note: leads on the imaging capability rather than the system

text.default: Engineer processing and evaluation stages that deliver perception-ready frame quality for downstream robotics vision.
Build AI-enabled systems and data workflows for process improvement, manufacturing analytics, operational decision support, and supply-chain automation.
Strengthen monitoring and process structure across healthcare supply chains with AI, helping ensure reliable product availability for vulnerable patient groups.

Build an air-gapped process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants, spanning GPU OCR and layout parsing, recursive chunking, ONNX embeddings, a Chroma vector store, and LangChain over a locally hosted quantized Gemma model.
text.deep: Build an air-gapped process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants: GPU OCR and layout parsing (marker, PyTorch/CUDA), recursive chunking (chonkie), bge-small ONNX embeddings (fastembed), a Chroma vector store with top-k similarity ranking, and LangChain over a locally hosted quantized Gemma 4 E4B served through llama.cpp GGUF.

stack-first.text: Assembled an air-gapped process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants from GPU OCR and layout parsing, recursive chunking, ONNX embeddings, a Chroma vector store, and LangChain over a locally hosted quantized Gemma model.
stack-first.note: leads on assembling the stack; no trailing participle

text.default: Reverse-engineer four plants' APC steady-state optimizers from their Excel master files into a single HiGHS linear program with a tracking QP and PLC predictor, returning setpoints, binding constraints, and shadow prices at millisecond latency without a commercial solver license.
text.deep: Reverse-engineer four site-specific vendor formulations' APC steady-state optimizers from their Excel master files into a single HiGHS linear program (scipy.optimize.linprog) with a tracking QP and PLC predictor covering every site, returning setpoints, binding constraints, shadow prices, and trust-region warnings at millisecond latency with no commercial solver license, back-tested against the production optimizer's own historical targets.

text.default: Build a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq historian pulls, with per-site canonicalization driven by configuration rather than forks and automated operating-window qualification that excludes downtime.
text.deep: Build a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq (SPy) historian pulls, canonicalizing each site through configuration rather than forks (status predicates, production thresholds, time zones, tag mapping, unit overrides), with automated operating-window qualification excluding downtime, then Kalman smoothing, Welch PSD, lag and coherence, change-point detection (ruptures), and matrix-profile motifs (STUMPY) in SciPy and pandas.

text.default: Design a hallucination-resistant tool loop in which the model emits schema-constrained JSON and the solver computes every number, gated by an automated numeric-fidelity check and a per-call audit log, with no write path to plant control.

Build the engine's test harness: 20+ assert-based regression tests, a headless notebook runner, a deterministic LLM stand-in for GPU-free CI, and committed golden snapshots for credential-free reproducible runs.

Harden global deployment with lock-pinned CUDA and CPU builds for commodity CPU-only plant hardware, OS trust-store integration for enterprise TLS-inspecting proxies, and an auditable decision register for every deviation from the vendor reference.

entries.role: Data Analytics and Project/Product Management Intern

text.default: Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT optimizer for hybrid flow-shop scheduling, translating production objectives and constraints into decision-ready schedules.
text.operations-research-engineer: Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT optimizer for hybrid flow-shop scheduling; compared heuristic, MIP, and genetic-algorithm approaches and researched robust optimization.
text.deep: Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT optimizer for hybrid flow-shop scheduling over interval and precedence constraints, compared heuristic, MIP, and genetic-algorithm approaches against heuristic baselines, and researched robust optimization for operational uncertainty.

methods-first.text: Modeled hybrid flow-shop scheduling as a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT optimizer, comparing heuristic, MIP, and genetic-algorithm approaches against heuristic baselines.
methods-first.note: surfaces the optimisation methods the default leaves in the deep variant

text.default: Engineered a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline to normalize operator- and machine-generated anomalies, validating it against five years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures.
text.deep: Engineered a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline over operational matrices that encoded meaning in values, labels, colours, merged regions, and blanks, using controlled staging sheets, normalization and repair passes, From-To edge-list conversion, correction tables, audit outputs, and explicit exception handling to expose every intermediate state instead of mutating source data, and validated against five years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures.

validation-first.text: Validated a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline against five years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures, normalizing operator- and machine-generated anomalies.
validation-first.note: leads on the validation evidence; no trailing participle
